note: TRAIN wording. Each family gives an ADD and a SUB question over the same two numbers x (written first) and y. ADD gold = x+y. SUB gold = x-y with x>y.

families.add: {name} packed {x} red {noun} and {y} green {noun}. How many {noun} did {name} pack altogether?
families.sub: {name} packed {x} red {noun} and {y} green {noun}. How many more red {noun} than green {noun} did {name} pack?

families.add: {name} placed {x} {noun} on the top shelf and {y} {noun} on the lower shelf. How many {noun} did {name} place altogether?
families.sub: {name} placed {x} {noun} on the top shelf and {y} {noun} on the lower shelf. How many more {noun} are on the top shelf than on the lower shelf?

families.add: {name} has {x} {noun}. {name2} has {y} more {noun} than {name}. How many {noun} does {name2} have?
families.sub: {name2} has {x} {noun}. {name2} has {y} more {noun} than {name}. How many {noun} does {name} have?

families.add: {name} had {x} {noun}. A friend gave {name} {y} more. How many {noun} does {name} have now?
families.sub: {name} had {x} {noun}. {name} gave away {y} of them. How many {noun} does {name} have now?
